title: Reservation extent

Reservations.description: Whether the response should contain reservations.

ReservationGroups.description: Whether the response should contain groups of the reservations.

Customers.description: Whether the response should contain customers of the reservations.

CustomerAdresses.description: Whether the response should contain addresses of the customers.

CustomerIdentityDocuments.description: Whether the response should contain identity documents of the customers.

Services.description: Whether the response should contain services reserved by the reservations.

Products.description: Whether the response should contain products orderable with the reservations.

BusinessSegments.description: Whether the response should contain business segmentation.

Resources.description: Whether the response should contain resources.

ResourceCategories.description: Whether the response should contain resource categories.

ResourceCategoryAssignments.description: Whether the response should contain assignments of the resources to categories.

Rates.description: Whether the response should contain rates and rate groups.

Items.description: Whether the response should contain accounting items.

OrderItems.description: Whether the response should contain reservation items.

Notes.description: Whether the response should contain notes.

QrCodeData.description: Whether the response should contain QR code data.

Companies.description: Whether the response should contain companies.

AccountingStates.description: States the items should be in. If not specified, items in `Open` or `Closed` states are returned.

description: Extent of data to be returned. E.g. it is possible to specify that together with the reservations, customers, groups and rates should be also returned.
